description:
Start a private bounded readiness job; returns immediately with a job ID.
    HTTP requires successful transport and 2xx; MCP requires initialize and complete
    tools/list; assert accepts assert_healthy conditions. Never invokes remote tools.
    Poll read_readiness_jobs every 15s. Stops on readiness, deadline, attempts or cap.
    Each completed diagnostic costs 1 credit, including broken targets; unavailable
    workers are free but count as attempts. Obtain owner spending consent. No cash
    charge. Reuse request_key on retry. Nothing starts without confirm=true.
name: wait_until_ready
